analysis: You opened this stretch on 14 July with a rough one — just under six hours — but then you went and pulled a nine-and-a-half hour night like your body was making a point, and honestly fair enough. The middle of the week was your sweet spot: 7h 40m, 7h 15m, nearly eight hours, REM sitting pretty around two hours most nights, and that 53-minute deep sleep on the 17th is the kind of number that makes the whole ritual stack feel worth it. The last two nights have been a bit scrappier though — your awake time crept up to 51 minutes and then a full hour twenty-two last night, which is your body chatting to you about something, not failing you. Overall you're averaging close to seven and a half hours across the seven nights, which is genuinely solid, and the fact that your worst night is behind you rather than in front of you is a very good sign.
